_doc: STATIC-CONTENT-1 (Rowan, 2026-11-25): static content is not autonomous. Read by foundation/staticcontent.py. A listed page whose visible text has not changed in max_unchanged_days is a finding (detector static-content). Exempt only pages that are meant to stay fixed, each with its reason; making a page change by touching its text is never the fix, binding it to a loop is.

exempt.reason: legal and policy text changes by decision, not by a loop
